Groin Strain.symptoms: Sharp pain in inner thigh/groin region (adductor longus) during side-to-side movements, kicking, or sprinting; Local adductor tenderness; Pain worsened by resisted hip adduction (squeezing knees together) or passive hip abduction; Localized swelling; Limping
symptoms_list: Sharp pain in inner thigh/groin region (adductor longus) during side-to-side movements, kicking, or sprinting
Pain worsened by resisted hip adduction (squeezing knees together) or passive hip abduction
clarifying_questions: 1. Jangh ke andar ki taraf (groin) me jhatka/khujli jaisa dard hua hai?
2. Dono ghutno ke beech ball dabane ya side me le jane par dard badhta hai?
3. Kicking karte hain?
investigations: Ultrasound Groin (evaluates adductor longus origin tear)
MRI Pelvis/Groin (rules out athletic pubalgia / osteitis pubis)
Groin Strain.treatment: Follow RICE protocol: Rest from sports, Ice pack wrapped in towel for 15 mins 3 times daily for 48h, Compression groin wrap; Perform gentle adductor squeezes once acute pain subsides; Avoid wide straddle stretches initially
Groin Strain.supportive_medicines: Topical Diclofenac gel; Groin spica wrap; Adductor strengthening exercises

medication_card.generic_drug: Paracetamol OR Aceclofenac + RICE Protocol
medication_card.precautions: First-line: RICE protocol and early gentle movement as pain allows; avoid heat and massage in first 48 hours. Oral NSAIDs short course after food. Differentiate from Inguinal Hernia, Sports Hernia (Athletic Pubalgia), and Hip joint pathology
home_care: Follow RICE protocol: Rest from sports, Ice pack wrapped in towel for 15 mins 3 times daily for 48h, Compression groin wrap
Perform gentle adductor squeezes once acute pain subsides
Avoid wide straddle stretches initially
lab_tests: Ultrasound Groin (evaluates adductor longus origin tear)
MRI Pelvis/Groin (rules out athletic pubalgia / osteitis pubis)
emergency_red_flags: Palpable bulge in groin worsening with coughing (Inguinal Hernia)
clarifying_questions: 1. Jangh ke andar ki taraf (groin) me jhatka/khujli jaisa dard hua hai?
2. Dono ghutno ke beech ball dabane ya side me le jane par dard badhta hai?
3. Kicking karte hain?

Groin Strain.precautions: First-line: RICE protocol and early gentle movement as pain allows; avoid heat and massage in first 48 hours. Oral NSAIDs short course after food. Differentiate from Inguinal Hernia, Sports Hernia (Athletic Pubalgia), and Hip joint pathology
home_care_advice: Follow RICE protocol: Rest from sports, Ice pack wrapped in towel for 15 mins 3 times daily for 48h, Compression groin wrap
Perform gentle adductor squeezes once acute pain subsides
Avoid wide straddle stretches initially
emergency_flags: Palpable bulge in groin worsening with coughing (Inguinal Hernia)

Shin Splints.name: Shin Splints
Shin Splints.hindi_names: Shin Splints; Pindali ke aage ka dard
Shin Splints.symptoms: Dull aching pain localized along posteromedial border of middle-to-distal tibia (shin bone) appearing during/after running or jumping; Diffuse tenderness over lower 1/3 of posteromedial tibia (spanning >5 cm); Mild localized edema; Pain worsened by ankle plantarflexion
symptoms_list: Dull aching pain localized along posteromedial border of middle-to-distal tibia (shin bone) appearing during/after running or jumping
Diffuse tenderness over lower 1/3 of posteromedial tibia (spanning >5 cm)
clarifying_questions: 1. Pair ki aage ki haddi (shin bone) ke andar ki patti par running ke baad dard hota hai?
2. Choone par 4-5 cm lamba dard ka hissa hai?
3. Naye joote ya hard surface par running shuru ki?
investigations: X-ray Shin/Tibia (AP and Lateral views - usually normal in early shin splints, excludes fracture)
MRI Tibia / Bone Scan (differentiates severe MTSS from stress fracture)
Shin Splints.treatment: Rest from running and high-impact activities; Switch to cross-training (swimming/cycling); Apply ice pack for 15 mins 3 times daily; Use proper shock-absorbing running shoes with arch support; Replace worn running shoes
medications: Shin stretching and calf strengthening exercises
Shin Splints.supportive_medicines: Topical Diclofenac gel; Shock-absorbing shoe insoles; Shin stretching and calf strengthening exercises

medication_card.generic_drug: Paracetamol OR Aceclofenac + Rest Protocol
supportive_medicines: Shin stretching and calf strengthening exercises
medication_card.precautions: Oral NSAIDs short course after food. Contraindicated in peptic ulcer, CKD, heart failure, HTN, pregnancy. Topical NSAIDs/Paracetamol first-line OTC choices. MUST DIFFERENTIATE SHIN SPLINTS FROM TIBIAL STRESS FRACTURE (stress fracture has focal point tenderness <2 cm)
home_care: Rest from running and high-impact activities
Switch to cross-training (swimming/cycling)
Apply ice pack for 15 mins 3 times daily
Use proper shock-absorbing running shoes with arch support
Replace worn running shoes
lab_tests: X-ray Shin/Tibia (AP and Lateral views - usually normal in early shin splints, excludes fracture)
MRI Tibia / Bone Scan (differentiates severe MTSS from stress fracture)
emergency_red_flags: Focal pinpoint severe bone tenderness <2 cm on tibia (Tibial Stress Fracture risk)
Tense swollen shin with severe numbness or weakness (Exertional Compartment Syndrome)
clarifying_questions: 1. Pair ki aage ki haddi (shin bone) ke andar ki patti par running ke baad dard hota hai?
2. Choone par 4-5 cm lamba dard ka hissa hai?
3. Naye joote ya hard surface par running shuru ki?

Shin Splints.precautions: Oral NSAIDs short course after food. Contraindicated in peptic ulcer, CKD, heart failure, HTN, pregnancy. Topical NSAIDs/Paracetamol first-line OTC choices. MUST DIFFERENTIATE SHIN SPLINTS FROM TIBIAL STRESS FRACTURE (stress fracture has focal point tenderness <2 cm)
home_care_advice: Rest from running and high-impact activities
Switch to cross-training (swimming/cycling)
Apply ice pack for 15 mins 3 times daily
Use proper shock-absorbing running shoes with arch support
Replace worn running shoes
emergency_flags: Focal pinpoint severe bone tenderness <2 cm on tibia (Tibial Stress Fracture risk)
Tense swollen shin with severe numbness or weakness (Exertional Compartment Syndrome)

Stress Fracture.name: Stress Fracture
Stress Fracture.hindi_names: Stress Fracture; Haddi me hairline crack
Stress Fracture.symptoms: Severe localized PINPOINT bone pain (tibia, metatarsals, navicular) worsened by weight-bearing/running and relieved ONLY by complete rest; Focal point tenderness <2 cm directly over bone; Localized bony edema; Pain progressing from post-activity to pain during walking
symptoms_list: Severe localized PINPOINT bone pain (tibia, metatarsals, navicular) worsened by weight-bearing/running and relieved ONLY by complete rest
Focal point tenderness <2 cm directly over bone
Pain progressing from post-activity to pain during walking
clarifying_questions: 1. Running/activity ke baad haddi par EK HI CHHOTE POINT par severe dard hai?
2. Wazan daalne par tez dard hota hai?
3. Training intensity achanak badhayi thi?
investigations: Plain X-rays (may be negative for first 2-3 weeks until periosteal reaction appears)
MRI Bone (Gold standard - detects early bone marrow edema)
Stress Fracture.treatment: Strictly avoid running, jumping, and weight-bearing on affected bone; Use a rigid pneumatic walking boot or crutches as advised; Apply ice packs for 15 mins twice daily; Ensure adequate Calcium and Vitamin D intake
medications: Paracetamol OR Acetaminophen + Strict Bone Offloading
Calcium Carbonate 500 mg + Vitamin D3 600 IU daily
Stress Fracture.generic_drug: Paracetamol OR Acetaminophen + Strict Bone Offloading
Stress Fracture.supportive_medicines: Calcium Carbonate 500 mg + Vitamin D3 600 IU daily; Rigid walking boot / cast immobilizer; Crutches for non-weight bearing

medication_card.generic_drug: Paracetamol OR Acetaminophen + Strict Bone Offloading
supportive_medicines: Calcium Carbonate 500 mg + Vitamin D3 600 IU daily
medication_card.precautions: STRICT OFF-LOADING / IMMOBILIZATION IS MANDATORY. Avoid oral NSAIDs (Ibuprofen/Aceclofenac) if possible, as NSAIDs inhibit prostaglandin-mediated osteoblast bone healing. Paracetamol is preferred analgesic
home_care: Strictly avoid running, jumping, and weight-bearing on affected bone
Use a rigid pneumatic walking boot or crutches as advised
Apply ice packs for 15 mins twice daily
Ensure adequate Calcium and Vitamin D intake
lab_tests: Plain X-rays (may be negative for first 2-3 weeks until periosteal reaction appears)
MRI Bone (Gold standard - detects early bone marrow edema)
emergency_red_flags: Complete fracture displacement with visible deformity
clarifying_questions: 1. Running/activity ke baad haddi par EK HI CHHOTE POINT par severe dard hai?
2. Wazan daalne par tez dard hota hai?
3. Training intensity achanak badhayi thi?

Stress Fracture.precautions: STRICT OFF-LOADING / IMMOBILIZATION IS MANDATORY. Avoid oral NSAIDs (Ibuprofen/Aceclofenac) if possible, as NSAIDs inhibit prostaglandin-mediated osteoblast bone healing. Paracetamol is preferred analgesic
home_care_advice: Strictly avoid running, jumping, and weight-bearing on affected bone
Use a rigid pneumatic walking boot or crutches as advised
Apply ice packs for 15 mins twice daily
Ensure adequate Calcium and Vitamin D intake
emergency_flags: Complete fracture displacement with visible deformity

Nocturnal Leg Cramps.name: Nocturnal Leg Cramps
Nocturnal Leg Cramps.hindi_names: Raat ko pairo me aedan; Leg Cramps
Nocturnal Leg Cramps.symptoms: Sudden, involuntary, painful contraction of calf, foot, or hamstring muscles occurring at night during sleep or rest, lasting seconds to minutes; Visible muscle knotting/hardness; Persistent residual muscle soreness next day; Sleep disruption; Normal neurological exam
symptoms_list: Sudden, involuntary, painful contraction of calf, foot, or hamstring muscles occurring at night during sleep or rest, lasting seconds to minutes
Persistent residual muscle soreness next day
clarifying_questions: 1. Raat ko sote me achanak pindali (calf) ya panje me tez dard-bhari aedan aati hai?
2. Aedan ke waqt manspeshi kadi ho jati hai?
3. Paani kam peete hain ya BP ki paani wali dawai chal rahi hai?
Nocturnal Leg Cramps.treatment: When cramp occurs, immediately perform passive stretch of calf (pull toes upward toward shin) and walk on heels; Perform calf stretching exercises for 5 mins before bedtime; Maintain high fluid intake during day; Take warm foot bath before sleep
medications: Stretching First-Line + Hydration & Electrolytes (QUININE IS NOT RECOMMENDED FOR ROUTINE USE)
Nocturnal Leg Cramps.generic_drug: Stretching First-Line + Hydration & Electrolytes (QUININE IS NOT RECOMMENDED FOR ROUTINE USE)
Nocturnal Leg Cramps.supportive_medicines: Magnesium Glycinate 250 mg at bedtime; Vitamin E 400 IU; Calcium + Vitamin D3 supplementation

medication_card.generic_drug: Stretching First-Line + Hydration & Electrolytes (QUININE IS NOT RECOMMENDED FOR ROUTINE USE)
medication_card.precautions: QUININE IS STRICTLY NOT RECOMMENDED FOR ROUTINE LEG CRAMPS DUE TO FATAL HEMATOLOGIC TOXICITY AND ARRHYTHMIAS. Check serum electrolytes, renal function, and medications (diuretics cause cramps). Stretching and hydration are primary first-line
home_care: When cramp occurs, immediately perform passive stretch of calf (pull toes upward toward shin) and walk on heels
Perform calf stretching exercises for 5 mins before bedtime
Maintain high fluid intake during day
Take warm foot bath before sleep
emergency_red_flags: Asymmetric persistent leg swelling (DVT rule out)

3. Paani kam peete hain ya BP ki paani wali dawai chal rahi hai?

Perform calf stretching exercises for 5 mins before bedtime
Maintain high fluid intake during day
Take warm foot bath before sleep

Sprained Ankle (Grade 1-2).name: Sprained Ankle (Grade 1-2)
Sprained Ankle (Grade 1-2).symptoms: Acute lateral ankle pain, rapid swelling, bruising, and tenderness following an inversion injury (twisting foot inward); Tenderness over anterior talofibular (ATFL) and calcaneofibular (CFL) ligaments; Mild-to-moderate ecchymosis; Antalgic gait
symptoms_list: Acute lateral ankle pain, rapid swelling, bruising, and tenderness following an inversion injury (twisting foot inward)
Tenderness over anterior talofibular (ATFL) and calcaneofibular (CFL) ligaments
clarifying_questions: 1. Pair ka takhna (ankle) andar ki taraf muda tha?
2. Ankle ke bahar ki taraf soojan aur neela-pan aaya hai?
3. Kya aap 4 kadam chal pa rahe hain?
investigations: X-ray Ankle AP, Lateral, and Mortise views (Mandatory if Ottawa Ankle Rules positive - rules out malleolar fracture)
Sprained Ankle (Grade 1-2).treatment: Follow RICE protocol: Rest with brace, Ice pack wrapped in cloth for 15 mins 3-4 times daily for 48h, Compression elastic wrap, Elevate ankle above heart level; Avoid heat/massage for 48h; Gentle active ankle range of motion as pain permits
medications: Paracetamol OR Aceclofenac / Ibuprofen + RICE Protocol
Sprained Ankle (Grade 1-2).generic_drug: Paracetamol OR Aceclofenac / Ibuprofen + RICE Protocol
Sprained Ankle (Grade 1-2).supportive_medicines: Topical Diclofenac gel; Semi-rigid ankle brace / Aircast; Crepe bandage wrap

medication_card.generic_drug: Paracetamol OR Aceclofenac / Ibuprofen + RICE Protocol
medication_card.precautions: First-line for sprain: RICE protocol (Rest, Ice, Compression, Elevation) and early protected movement as pain permits; avoid heat and massage in first 48 hours. Apply Ottawa Ankle Rules: X-ray mandatory if unable to bear weight immediately and in ER for 4 steps, or bone tenderness over malleoli
home_care: Follow RICE protocol: Rest with brace, Ice pack wrapped in cloth for 15 mins 3-4 times daily for 48h, Compression elastic wrap, Elevate ankle above heart level
Avoid heat/massage for 48h
Gentle active ankle range of motion as pain permits
lab_tests: X-ray Ankle AP, Lateral, and Mortise views (Mandatory if Ottawa Ankle Rules positive - rules out malleolar fracture)
emergency_red_flags: Ottawa Ankle Rules positive: Inability to bear weight for 4 steps, or severe bone tenderness at posterior tip of malleoli / 5th metatarsal base (Fracture risk)

2. Ankle ke bahar ki taraf soojan aur neela-pan aaya hai?

Avoid heat/massage for 48h
Gentle active ankle range of motion as pain permits

Lateral Ankle Instability.name: Lateral Ankle Instability
Lateral Ankle Instability.symptoms: Recurrent feeling of ankle 'giving way' or collapsing during walking/sports on uneven surfaces, secondary to prior unhealed sprains; Recurrent minor ankle sprains; Chronic lateral ankle aching; Feeling of apprehension on uneven ground; Positive anterior drawer test of ankle
symptoms_list: Recurrent feeling of ankle 'giving way' or collapsing during walking/sports on uneven surfaces, secondary to prior unhealed sprains
Feeling of apprehension on uneven ground
Positive anterior drawer test of ankle
clarifying_questions: 1. Takhna baar-baar mudta (give way karta) hai?
2. Purani ankle sprain chot ki history hai?
3. Uneven road par chalne me darr lagta hai?
investigations: Stress X-rays Ankle (Anterior drawer and Talar tilt stress views)
MRI Ankle (evaluates ATFL/CFL chronic tear and osteochondral lesions of talus)
Lateral Ankle Instability.treatment: Perform single-leg balance exercises and wobble board training daily to rebuild proprioception; Wear a supportive semi-rigid ankle brace during sports or walking on rough terrain; Strengthen peroneal muscles
medications: Paracetamol OR Aceclofenac (Short course during acute tweaks) + Proprioceptive Rehab
Peroneal muscle strengthening & wobble board proprioceptive rehab
Lateral Ankle Instability.generic_drug: Paracetamol OR Aceclofenac (Short course during acute tweaks) + Proprioceptive Rehab
Lateral Ankle Instability.supportive_medicines: Semi-rigid functional ankle brace; Peroneal muscle strengthening & wobble board proprioceptive rehab; Anatomical ligament reconstruction (under specialist)

medication_card.generic_drug: Paracetamol OR Aceclofenac (Short course during acute tweaks) + Proprioceptive Rehab
supportive_medicines: Peroneal muscle strengthening & wobble board proprioceptive rehab
medication_card.precautions: Oral NSAIDs short course after food for acute tweaks. Primary cure is proprioceptive rehab and peroneal muscle strengthening. Reconstructive surgery (Broström procedure) Rx under orthopedic specialist for failed rehab
home_care: Perform single-leg balance exercises and wobble board training daily to rebuild proprioception
Wear a supportive semi-rigid ankle brace during sports or walking on rough terrain
Strengthen peroneal muscles
lab_tests: Stress X-rays Ankle (Anterior drawer and Talar tilt stress views)
MRI Ankle (evaluates ATFL/CFL chronic tear and osteochondral lesions of talus)

Wear a supportive semi-rigid ankle brace during sports or walking on rough terrain
Strengthen peroneal muscles

Achilles Tendinitis.name: Achilles Tendinitis
Achilles Tendinitis.hindi_names: Achilles Tendon ka dard; Heel Cord Pain
Achilles Tendinitis.symptoms: Pain and stiffness along Achilles tendon (back of heel/lower calf), worst in morning or with first steps after rest; Tendon thickening or localized nodule 2-6 cm proximal to insertion (Midportion) or at calcaneal insertion (Insertional); Morning stiffness; Crepitus
symptoms_list: Pain and stiffness along Achilles tendon (back of heel/lower calf), worst in morning or with first steps after rest
Tendon thickening or localized nodule 2-6 cm proximal to insertion (Midportion) or at calcaneal insertion (Insertional)
clarifying_questions: 1. Pair ke piche aedi ke upar ki nass (Achilles tendon) me dard hai?
2. Subah pehle kadam rakhne par ya running ke baad badhta hai?
3. Nass moti lagti hai?
investigations: Ultrasound Achilles Tendon (evaluates tendon thickness, neovascularization, and intratendinous tears)
Achilles Tendinitis.treatment: Perform eccentric calf drop exercises (Alfredson protocol) twice daily; Use silicone heel cups in shoes to reduce tendon strain; Apply ice packs for 15 mins post activity; Avoid flat barefoot walking
medications: Paracetamol OR Aceclofenac / Naproxen + Eccentric Rehab
Achilles Tendinitis.generic_drug: Paracetamol OR Aceclofenac / Naproxen + Eccentric Rehab
Achilles Tendinitis.supportive_medicines: Topical Diclofenac gel; Silicone heel cups/lifts (0.5-1 cm); Eccentric calf loading exercises (Alfredson protocol)

medication_card.generic_drug: Paracetamol OR Aceclofenac / Naproxen + Eccentric Rehab
medication_card.precautions: Oral NSAIDs short course after food. Contraindicated in peptic ulcer, CKD, heart failure, HTN, 3rd trimester pregnancy. STEROID INJECTIONS INTO OR AROUND ACHILLES TENDON ARE STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED DUE TO HIGH RISK OF TENDON RUPTURE
home_care: Perform eccentric calf drop exercises (Alfredson protocol) twice daily
Use silicone heel cups in shoes to reduce tendon strain
Apply ice packs for 15 mins post activity
Avoid flat barefoot walking
lab_tests: Ultrasound Achilles Tendon (evaluates tendon thickness, neovascularization, and intratendinous tears)
emergency_red_flags: Sudden loud 'pop' or 'snap' at back of ankle followed by immediate inability to push off foot (Achilles Tendon Rupture emergency)

2. Subah pehle kadam rakhne par ya running ke baad badhta hai?
3. Nass moti lagti hai?

Apply ice packs for 15 mins post activity

Achilles Tendon Rupture (Emergency).name: Achilles Tendon Rupture (Emergency)
Achilles Tendon Rupture (Emergency).symptoms: Sudden catastrophic 'pop' or feeling of being kicked in back of ankle during pushing-off, followed by immediate inability to plantarflex foot or walk; Positive Thompson Squeeze Test (absence of foot plantarflexion when squeezing calf muscle); Palpable gap in tendon 2-6 cm above calcaneus; Marked limping
symptoms_list: Sudden catastrophic 'pop' or feeling of being kicked in back of ankle during pushing-off, followed by immediate inability to plantarflex foot or walk
Positive Thompson Squeeze Test (absence of foot plantarflexion when squeezing calf muscle)
Palpable gap in tendon 2-6 cm above calcaneus
clarifying_questions: 1. Pair ke piche aedi ke upar jhatke ke sath 'pop' ki awaaz aayi thi?
2. Panje par khade hone me bilkul kamzori hai?
3. Calf squeeze karne par panja hilti nahi hai?
investigations: MRI Ankle/Achilles (confirms full-thickness tear gap size)
Achilles Tendon Rupture (Emergency).treatment: Immobilize ankle immediately in a plantarflexed (pointed toes downward) position using a splint or rigid support; Avoid all weight-bearing; Transfer patient to emergency room
medications: Rigid Equinus Splint (foot in full plantarflexion)
Surgical Tendon Repair or Functional Equinus Cast Protocol
indian_brands: Injection Tramadol / Oral Analgesics for transport pain
Achilles Tendon Rupture (Emergency).dosage_frequency: Immediate Equinus rigid splinting + Orthopedic Surgery / Functional Rehabilitation evaluation
Achilles Tendon Rupture (Emergency).supportive_medicines: Immediate ER / Orthopedic Referral; Rigid Equinus Splint (foot in full plantarflexion); Surgical Tendon Repair or Functional Equinus Cast Protocol

Plantar Fasciitis (Heel Pain).name: Plantar Fasciitis (Heel Pain)
Plantar Fasciitis (Heel Pain).symptoms: STABBING PAIN AT BOTTOM OF HEEL WITH FIRST STEPS IN THE MORNING or after prolonged sitting; Pain eases with initial walking then worsens late in day; Point tenderness localized strictly over medial calcaneal tuberosity; Pain worsened by passive dorsiflexion of toes (Windlass mechanism); Tight calf muscles
symptoms_list: STABBING PAIN AT BOTTOM OF HEEL WITH FIRST STEPS IN THE MORNING or after prolonged sitting
Pain eases with initial walking then worsens late in day
Point tenderness localized strictly over medial calcaneal tuberosity
Pain worsened by passive dorsiflexion of toes (Windlass mechanism)
clarifying_questions: 1. Subah zameen par pehla kadam rakhne par aedi me tez sui-jaisa dard hota hai?
2. Kuch kadam chalne ke baad dard thoda kam hota hai?
3. Barefoot chalne par badhta hai?
investigations: X-ray Calcaneus Lateral view (may show calcaneal spur, but spur is not primary cause)
Ultrasound Plantar Fascia (shows fascia thickening >4 mm)
Plantar Fasciitis (Heel Pain).treatment: Roll arch of foot over a frozen water bottle for 10 mins twice daily; Perform plantar fascia and calf stretches before getting out of bed; Wear cushioned footwear with good arch support indoors; Never walk barefoot on hard floors
medications: Paracetamol OR Aceclofenac / Naproxen + Plantar Stretching
Silicone heel cushions / Orthotic arch supports
Plantar fascia local steroid / PRP injection (specialist-administered)
Plantar Fasciitis (Heel Pain).generic_drug: Paracetamol OR Aceclofenac / Naproxen + Plantar Stretching
Plantar Fasciitis (Heel Pain).supportive_medicines: Topical Diclofenac gel; Silicone heel cushions / Orthotic arch supports; Night splint; Plantar fascia local steroid / PRP injection (specialist-administered)

medication_card.generic_drug: Paracetamol OR Aceclofenac / Naproxen + Plantar Stretching
supportive_medicines: Silicone heel cushions / Orthotic arch supports
Plantar fascia local steroid / PRP injection (specialist-administered)
medication_card.precautions: Oral NSAIDs short course (3-5 days) after food. Contraindicated in peptic ulcer, CKD, heart failure, HTN, 3rd trimester pregnancy. Local steroid injections Rx and doctor-administered (use sparingly as repeated injections cause plantar fat pad atrophy / fascia rupture)
home_care: Roll arch of foot over a frozen water bottle for 10 mins twice daily
Perform plantar fascia and calf stretches before getting out of bed
Wear cushioned footwear with good arch support indoors
Never walk barefoot on hard floors

Acute Seizure First Aid (Emergency).symptoms: Sudden onset tonic-clonic convulsions, loss of consciousness, body stiffening, violent muscle jerking, frothing at mouth, and eye rolling; Tongue biting; Urinary or fecal incontinence; Post-ictal deep sleep, confusion, and muscle soreness

Acute Seizure First Aid (Emergency).treatment: First Aid Protocol: 1. Lay the person gently on their side (recovery position) to clear airway; 2. Clear the surrounding area of sharp or hard objects; 3. Loosen tight clothing around neck; 4. Place a soft cushion under head; 5. Note the exact time seizure started; 6. Do NOT put anything in mouth; 7. Do NOT restrain them; 8. Call emergency services (112) immediately if seizure lasts >5 minutes, repeats, or person does not wake up

Antidepressant Discontinuation Syndrome.precautions: NEVER STOP OR CHANGE ANTIDEPRESSANT DOSES ON YOUR OWN. ALWAYS TAPER GRADUALLY UNDER DOCTOR GUIDANCE OVER SEVERAL WEEKS TO MONTHS. Antidepressant discontinuation syndrome is NOT addictive dependence, but a physical neurochemical adjustment. Short half-life drugs (Paroxetine, Venlafaxine) carry the highest risk. Restarting the original dose resolves symptoms within 24 hours, followed by a planned slow taper

Do NOT stop taking your antidepressants 'cold turkey'
Understand that 'brain zaps' are harmless withdrawal sensations that will pass

Ulti jaisa lagta hai ya khata paani gale me aata hai?
investigations: H. pylori stool antigen or urea breath test if chronic
Upper GI endoscopy if persistent > 2 weeks or red flags
Gastritis.treatment: Proton pump inhibitor (PPI) therapy 30 minutes before breakfast, antacid gel for instant relief, dietary modification, and avoiding NSAID painkillers.
Gastritis.dosage_frequency: OD (Once daily, 30 minutes before morning breakfast)
supportive_medicines: Antacid gel (Gelusil / Digene 10 ml after food SOS)
Gastritis.precautions: Take strictly 30-45 minutes before morning breakfast on empty stomach for maximum acid suppression. Avoid NSAIDs (brufen, aspirin) without gastroprotection. Stop smoking and alcohol. Eat smaller frequent meals.
home_care_advice: Eat smaller, more frequent meals rather than large heavy meals
Avoid extremely spicy, oily, deep-fried food and citrus/caffeine
Do not lie down immediately after eating (wait at least 2 hours)
Drink adequate water between meals rather than large quantities during meals
emergency_flags: Vomiting coffee-ground material or fresh blood (hematemesis)
Severe persistent burning pain radiating to the back

medication_card.generic_drug: Pantoprazole 40 mg
supportive_medicines: Antacid gel (Gelusil / Digene SOS after meals)
medication_card.precautions: Take on empty stomach before breakfast; avoid NSAID painkillers; avoid spicy and deep-fried food.
home_care: Eat smaller, frequent light meals
Avoid spicy, acidic, and oily foods
Do not lie down immediately after eating
Limit caffeine and tea intake

Generalized Fatigue & Weakness Evaluatio.name: Generalized Fatigue & Weakness Evaluation
Generalized Fatigue & Weakness Evaluatio.hindi_names: शारीरिक कमजोरी और थकान मूल्यांकन (Kamzori Aur Thakan)
Generalized Fatigue & Weakness Evaluatio.typical_duration: Days to weeks until underlying cause is treated
Generalized Fatigue & Weakness Evaluatio.symptoms: Generalized physical exhaustion, lethargy, low stamina, feeling drained, morning fatigue, unrefreshing sleep, mild brain fog
clarifying_questions: Kya thakan ke saath saans phoolti hai, chakkar aate hain, ya skin peeli/pale lagti hai? (Anemia check)
Kya pichle kuch dino/mahino me wajan achanak badha ya ghata hai, ya sardi/garmi zyada lagti hai? (Thyroid check)
Kya pyaas zyada lagti hai, bhookh zyada lagti hai aur peshab bar-bar aata hai? (Diabetes / Blood sugar check)
Kya neend theek se puri ho rahi hai aur pichle kuch dino me bohot zyada stress ya mental exhaustion raha hai?
Kya halka bukhar, body ache, ya kisi viral infection ke baad se yeh kamzori shuru hui hai? (Post-viral recovery check)
investigations: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with Peripheral Smear
Thyroid Profile (TSH, Free T3, Free T4)
Generalized Fatigue & Weakness Evaluatio.treatment: Comprehensive diagnostic laboratory workup to identify underlying root cause, nutritional replenishment, proper sleep hygiene (7-8 hours), and hydration.
medications: Specific therapy based on lab confirmation
Generalized Fatigue & Weakness Evaluatio.generic_drug: Multivitamins with Minerals (Supportive pending lab results)
Generalized Fatigue & Weakness Evaluatio.dosage_frequency: OD (Once daily after lunch or breakfast)
Generalized Fatigue & Weakness Evaluatio.precautions: Do not ignore persistent fatigue lasting > 2 weeks without a clinical blood workup. Avoid excessive caffeine intake which worsens adrenal fatigue. Consult a doctor for targeted prescription if anemia or thyroid is suspected.
home_care_advice: Maintain a regular sleep schedule: 7 to 8 hours nightly in a dark room
Stay well hydrated with clean water, lemon water, and coconut water
Include iron and protein rich foods (spinach, lentils, eggs, dates, almonds)
Engage in light morning walking (15-20 mins) to stimulate circulation
emergency_flags: Sudden severe shortness of breath or chest pain on minimal movement
Sudden fainting, loss of consciousness, or blackouts
Unexplained rapid weight loss or persistent high fever with night sweats
Blood in stool or black tarry stools

medication_card.generic_drug: Multivitamins with Minerals & Zinc
medication_card.precautions: Complete diagnostic blood panel (CBC, TSH, HbA1c) recommended if fatigue persists > 2 weeks; do not rely solely on supplements.
home_care: Ensure 7 to 8 hours restful sleep nightly
Drink 2.5 to 3 liters water daily
Eat balanced meals with leafy greens, pulses, and fruits
Avoid excessive caffeine
emergency_red_flags: Chest pain or breathlessness on mild exertion
Unexplained high fever or night sweats
clarifying_questions: 1. Saans phoolti hai ya skin peeli lagti hai?
2. Wajan me koi achanak badlaav aaya hai?
3. Pyaas ya peshab zyada aata hai?

Dizziness & Vertigo Evaluation.name: Dizziness & Vertigo Evaluation
Dizziness & Vertigo Evaluation.hindi_names: चक्कर आना और संतुलन में कमी (Chakkar / Sar Ghumna)
Dizziness & Vertigo Evaluation.symptoms: Feeling of head spinning, unsteadiness, lightheadedness on standing, loss of balance, nausea, feeling faint
clarifying_questions: Kya sar ghumne ka ehsaas gardan ghumane ya let kar uthne par hota hai? (BPPV / Inner ear check)
Kya achanak khade hone par aankhon ke aage andhera chha jata hai? (Orthostatic hypotension / Low BP check)
Kya kaano me seeti jaisi aawaz (tinnitus) ya sunne me koi kami mehsus hoti hai?
Kya paani kam peene se dehydration ya kamzori aur thakan lag rahi hai?
Kya chest discomfort, ghabrahat ya irregular heartbeat mehsus hoti hai?
investigations: Supine and standing blood pressure (Orthostatic BP check)
Dix-Hallpike clinical test for inner ear vertigo
Audiometry (hearing test) if ear ringing present
Dizziness & Vertigo Evaluation.treatment: Canalith repositioning maneuvers (Epley maneuver) for positional vertigo, vestibular suppressants short-term, hydration, and gradual positional changes.
medications: Betahistine 16 mg TDS (for true spinning vertigo)
Dizziness & Vertigo Evaluation.duration_days: 5 to 7 days as advised by doctor
Dizziness & Vertigo Evaluation.precautions: Caution in patients with bronchial asthma or peptic ulcer disease. Do not drive or operate machinery during dizzy spells. Sit down immediately if room begins spinning.
home_care_advice: When waking up, sit on bed for 1-2 minutes before standing up
Avoid sudden, jerky head movements
Stay well hydrated with at least 2.5 liters of water daily
Keep pathways clear of tripping hazards
emergency_flags: Sudden severe dizziness with double vision, slurred speech, or weakness in face/arms (stroke red flag)
Sudden complete hearing loss in one ear
Dizziness accompanied by chest pain or shortness of breath

medication_card.generic_drug: Betahistine 16 mg
medication_card.precautions: Caution in asthma or peptic ulcer; avoid driving during dizzy episodes; sit down immediately if balance lost.
home_care: Sit up slowly from lying down position
Avoid sudden neck or head jerks
Drink 2-3 liters water daily
Rest in a quiet seated position until spell passes
emergency_red_flags: Dizziness with slurred speech, facial droop, or arm weakness (Stroke warning)
clarifying_questions: 1. Sar ghumta hai ya andhera chha jata hai?
2. Khade hone par badhta hai ya gardan hilane par?
3. Kaano me seeti ya sunne me dikkat hai?
